_meta.Title: Refactor ratchet data
_meta.Purpose: Hold the best-ever-measured value, the goal, and the plan's 2026-09-09 starting point for every number the phase 0 refactor is only allowed to improve.
_meta.Used for: scripts/ratchet.py measure|check|update reads and writes this file. Nothing else should hand-edit the "best" numbers.
_meta.Solves: Gives "did the refactor make this worse" one saved number to compare against instead of a guess.
_meta.Does not: Enforce the target on its own -- scripts/ratchet.py check only fails when a number is worse than the recorded best, not when it is merely short of the target.

files_over_400_lines.label: Files over 400 lines (app code, both sides)
files_over_400_lines.measured_by: line count over src/**/*.ts(x) (excluding tests) plus main.py and py_modules/**/*.py

fe_long_functions_uncommented.label: Outermost front-end functions over 60 lines with no leading comment

be_long_functions_no_docstring.label: Back-end functions over 60 lines with no docstring
be_long_functions_no_docstring.measured_by: Python ast, over main.py and py_modules/**/*.py

raw_call_sites.label: Raw call() sites outside the four allowed
raw_call_sites.measured_by: grep for call( and callDeckyWithTimeout( in front-end app code, minus clear_plugin_data / install_rag_corpus_local / start_voice_transcription / stop_voice_transcription

fe_calls_with_no_be_method.label: Front-end call names with no back-end method
fe_calls_with_no_be_method.measured_by: rpc-map.json method names compared against call()/callDeckyWithTimeout( names grepped from front-end app code

be_methods_with_no_caller.label: Back-end methods with no caller
be_methods_with_no_caller.measured_by: rpc-map.json method names compared against call()/callDeckyWithTimeout( names grepped from front-end app code

settings_field_list_repeats.label: Places the settings field list is repeated in the settings hook
settings_field_list_repeats.measured_by: scripts/ratchet.py, a line-run rule over src/hooks/usePluginSettings.ts (see the comment above metric_settings_field_list_repeats)

doc_size_kb_roadmap.label: Living doc size: roadmap
doc_size_kb_roadmap.measured_by: byte count of docs/roadmap.md, divided by 1024
doc_size_kb_roadmap.advisory_reason: open work is added to these every time something lands, so they may drift up; the ceiling is what stops them ballooning back

doc_size_kb_testing.label: Living doc size: testing
doc_size_kb_testing.measured_by: byte count of docs/testing.md, divided by 1024
doc_size_kb_testing.advisory_reason: open work is added to these every time something lands, so they may drift up; the ceiling is what stops them ballooning back

doc_size_kb_claude.label: Living doc size: orientation (CLAUDE.md)
doc_size_kb_claude.measured_by: byte count of CLAUDE.md, divided by 1024

doc_size_kb_agents.label: Living doc size: neutral guide (AGENTS.md)
doc_size_kb_agents.measured_by: byte count of AGENTS.md, divided by 1024

live_docs_mentioning_cursor.label: Live docs mentioning Cursor
live_docs_mentioning_cursor.measured_by: grep over docs/ (excluding docs/archive/ and anything named changelog) for .cursorrules, cursor/*, or Cursor as a proper noun
